title: Remove pricing page/section from the website

requirements.text: Remove the Pricing page content so the website does not display any pricing tiers, package prices, or currency amounts.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting the former pricing route does not show any pricing tiers or prices (e.g., no "$99", "From $249", package cards with prices, etc.).
No other page shows pricing tiers or package prices.

requirements.text: Update the main navigation to remove the "Pricing" link so users are not directed to a pricing page.
acceptanceCriteria: Top navigation (desktop and mobile) no longer includes a link labeled "Pricing" that routes to /pricing.

requirements.text: Update the footer links to remove the "Pricing" link from the "Quick Links" section.
acceptanceCriteria: Footer "Quick Links" section no longer includes a "Pricing" link pointing to /pricing.

requirements.text: Ensure the /pricing route does not break existing navigation/bookmarks by converting it into a non-pricing page that directs users to request a quote via the Contact page.
acceptanceCriteria: /pricing remains a valid route (no blank page or runtime error).
The /pricing page contains only non-pricing copy (in English) that tells users pricing is available upon request and provides a clear call-to-action link/button to /contact.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx.
nonGoals: Domain/DNS configuration or providing a custom domain name.
Changing backend data models or adding new backend endpoints.
